title: Fix flashlight aim rotator keys
objective: Fix examples/flashlight/run.py D-pad flashlight aim crash caused by Exception: 'Yaw'.
instructions: Use the user runtime log as evidence: toggle works, then D-pad aim path crashes with engine_service Exception: 'Yaw'.
Investigate the actual key names used by viewport_desc['camera_rotation'] in existing examples/utilities; do not assume Yaw/Pitch keys.
Fix get_aimed_light_rotation so it handles SPEAR rotator key shape robustly and returns a valid rotator for K2_SetActorRotation.
Prefer preserving all existing D-pad CLI controls and behavior.
Do not reintroduce FKey object construction; keep the safe KeyName dict input path.
expected_outputs: Root cause and fix for Yaw exception.
definition_of_done: D-pad aim no longer indexes missing Yaw/Pitch keys directly.
